en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4307 - Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz narrated from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)
that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) disliked that a man should feed others as expiation for an oath before breaking it.
